original.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 fixes the format of taints written into Bottlerocket settings.

decision.reason: [ev-5506a0d4614a] lists "bottlerocket settings taint format (#6489)" under Bug Fixes. That is a fix to how taints are formatted in Bottlerocket settings. The subject name protocol-behavior "bottlerocket-settings-taint-format" uses only the evidence's own words, and behavior-changed with no before/after values is the most cautious change type the bugfix supports. Confidence is low because the excerpt is only a title: it does not describe the old or new format, and no validator could check this.
